title: Mypy plugin crashes when using instances as relationship.collection_class

labels.name: SQLA mypy plugin
labels.description: mypy plugin issues only.  general pep-484 issues should be "typing"

body:
**Describe the bug**
When using an instance as `relationship.collection_class` the mypy plugin crashes. It works for types as `list`, `set`, `dict`. However, not using [custom collection implementations](https://docs.sqlalchemy.org/en/14/orm/collections.html#custom-collection-implementations) like those in `sqlalchemy.orm.collections` or `sqlalchemy.ext.orderinglist`.

**Expected behavior**
I'm little unsure here, it could use the type of the instance or perhaps check for the `__emulates__` attribute mentioned in the custom collection docs?

**To Reproduce**
```py
from sqlalchemy import Column, Integer, ForeignKey
from sqlalchemy.orm import registry, relationship
from sqlalchemy.ext.orderinglist import OrderingList

mapper_registry: registry = registry()

@mapper_registry.mapped
class A:
    __tablename__ = "a"
    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)

    parent = relationship("A", collection_class=OrderingList("ordering"))
    parent_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey("a.id"))
    ordering = Column(Integer)
```
